g.text: “Your attack surface just met its match.” — Jean-Claude Van Damme, Bloodsport
“No bugs left standing.” — Jean-Claude Van Damme, Kickboxer
“Every vulnerability has a weak spot.” — Jean-Claude Van Damme, Universal Soldier
“Code hard. Review harder.” — Jean-Claude Van Damme, Double Impact
“Security is not a suggestion. It’s a roundhouse kick.” — Jean-Claude Van Damme, Timecop
“Breaking threats. Not your code.” — Jean-Claude Van Damme, Hard Target
“The code fights back. We fight harder.” — Jean-Claude Van Damme, The Quest
